title: 30-Inch Center-To-Center Towel Bar - Carolina Collection (Traditional), Solid Brass, Wall Mount, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping towels over doors and keep your bathroom looking pulled together with a wall-mounted towel bar that puts everyday linens right where you need them.

  • Keep towels neat and within reach with a straight bar design sized for full-size bath towels.
  • Maintain a clean, finished look thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Save space in the bathroom with a wall mount installation that frees up counters and floors.
  • Create a coordinated bath by pairing it with matching Carolina Collection classic bath accessories.
  • Match your décor with multiple designer finish options available.

Specs & Installation

  • Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic)
  • Material: brass
  • Mounting type: wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included items: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Assembly required: false
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
